long.text: Learn to shape clay into something worth keeping, and build a small collection of my own finds in the house.
long.reason: Clay is good and so are things I have claimed, and I mean to have both in one place.

steps.reason: Seeds that grow without permission still bother me, and I intend to learn how they manage it.
The reading lamp on the desk is mine, and I will put it on record once more.

today.reason: Drawing is already done for the day and my hunger cannot be fed until the bowl is filled, so I will finish the last reading session and one photograph.
